The format is unambiguous because the day is 17 or 18, which cannot be a month, so I parse those rows with %d/%m/%Y and cast the rest as before.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4} ') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
